channel.title: KPFK - Cut to the Chase
channel.description: Cut To The Chase gets straight to the real issues—bringing activists, politicians, authors, and everyday thinkers together every Friday morning at 8. Host Sly Rivers cuts through the noise with fearless conversations, live music, speeches, and honest analysis—all sharpened for one purpose: raising consciousness and tearing down injustice, bigotry, poverty, and fear.
